# `nkp demo nest`

```text
Nest commands

Usage:
  nkp demo nest [command]

Available Commands:
  aks            Short name
  preprovisioned Long hyphenated name with single space

Flags:
  -h, --help   Help for nest
```

## Subcommands

### `nkp demo nest aks`

```text
AKS help
```

### `nkp demo nest preprovisioned`

```text
Preprovisioned help
```
